name: labour and birth overview
title: Normal labour and birth by stage: the first stage is watched on the cervix, contractions and the fetal heart, with continuous monitoring for high risk read as normal, atypical or abnormal and intrauterine resuscitation when it is not normal; the second stage on station; the third on the signs of placental separation with active management and repair of tears; the fourth on the mother's vitals, with slow labour and postpartum hemorrhage sent to the abnormal labour chart

root.title: Normal labour: which stage is she in, what do I watch, and when do I act?
lines: labour = regular contractions causing progressive cervical dilation (Braxton Hicks: painless, NO cervical change)
first check there is no contraindication to labour: see the ABNORMAL LABOUR chart
